entities.name: Mupirocin (CID 4264)
observations: The provided structure resolves to PubChem CID 4264, molecular formula C26H44O9, consistent with mupirocin/pseudomonic acid A.

entities.name: Q4ZXH7 cytosol aminopeptidase
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference Q4ZXH7 is an exact 100%-identity, full-length match to the submitted sequence; annotated as a probable cytosol aminopeptidase.
Annotated to bind two Mn(2+) ions per subunit and remove unsubstituted N-terminal amino acids from peptides; leucine is preferred, with other residues possible.

entities.name: N-terminal amino acid hydrolysis
observations: Hydrolyzes the peptide bond after the N-terminal residue: peptide + H2O → shortened peptide + free N-terminal amino acid; reported substrate preference is often leucine.

entities.name: Manganese(II) ion
observations: Reference Q4ZXH7 annotation reports binding two Mn(2+) ions per subunit.
